title: For all the set of cards that has Japanese translation, what is the percent
question:
For all the set of cards that has Japanese translation, what is the percentage of them are only available in non-foil?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Japanese translation refers to language = 'Japanese'; in non-foil refers to isNonFoilOnly = 1; percentage of Japanese non foil in Japanese cards refers to DIVIDE(SUM(isNonFoilOnly = 1), SUM(language = 'Japanese'))*100
